# exoscale_ai_deployment (Resource)

Manage Exoscale [AI Deployments](https://community.exoscale.com/product/concrete-ai/dedicated-inference/overview/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "exoscale_ai_model" "my_ai_model" {
  zone = "at-vie-2"
  name = "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B"
}

resource "exoscale_ai_deployment" "my_ai_deployment" {
  zone      = "at-vie-2"
  name      = "my-ai-deployment"
  model_id  = exoscale_ai_model.my_ai_model.id
  gpu_type  = "gpu3080ti"
  gpu_count = 1
  replicas  = 1

  inference_engine_parameters = [
    "--max-model-len=4096",
  ]
}
```

Please refer to the [examples](https://github.com/exoscale/terraform-provider-exoscale/tree/master/examples/)
directory for complete configuration examples.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gpu_count` (Number) ❗ The number of GPUs per replica (`1`-`8`).
- `gpu_type` (String) ❗ The GPU type family (e.g. `gpua5000`, `gpu3080ti`). The available GPU types are listed by `exo dedicated-inference deployment instance-type`. Your organization GPU limits must allow the deployment: check them with `exo limits`.
- `model_id` (String) ❗ The ID of the [`exoscale_ai_model`](./ai_model.md) to deploy.
- `name` (String) The deployment name.
- `replicas` (Number) The number of replicas.
- `zone` (String) ❗ The Exoscale [Zone](https://www.exoscale.com/datacenters/) name.

### Optional

- `inference_engine_parameters` (Set of String) Extra inference engine server arguments (e.g. `["--max-tokens=4096", "--enable-prefix-caching"]`). The supported parameters are listed by `exo dedicated-inference deployment create --inference-engine-parameter-help`.
- `inference_engine_version` (String) The inference engine (vLLM) version (e.g. `0.30.0`). Defaults to the API default version. The supported versions and the default are listed in the [Exoscale API reference](https://community.exoscale.com/reference/api/ai/dedicated-inference/deployment/#create-deployment).
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The deployment creation date.
- `deployment_url` (String) The deployment inference endpoint URL.
- `id` (String) The AI deployment ID.
- `service_level` (String) The deployment service level.
- `state` (String) The deployment state (`creating`, `preparing`, `deploying`, `ready`, `scaling`, `updating`, `error`).
- `state_details` (String) The deployment state details.
- `updated_at` (String) The deployment last update date.

## Import

```shell
# An existing AI deployment may be imported by `<ID>@<zone>`:

terraform import \
  exoscale_ai_deployment.my_ai_deployment \
  f81d4fae-7dec-11d0-a765-00a0c91e6bf6@at-vie-2
```
